verdict.rationale: Runpod's core product is a hosted GPU cloud/marketplace; while the CLI (runpodctl) is open source, there is no evidence of a self-hostable version of the actual compute-orchestration platform, control plane, or marketplace that a user could run on their own infrastructure. The evidence pack only shows open-source client tooling (CLI, MCP client integration) and hosted APIs/services, not a self-hostable core product.
